explanation: Merging main keeps its App-rendering tests awaiting preloadAppViews(), its lazyView and originHealth coverage, and its compareDownloads regression for blank compare-set group means on unmeasured genes. This branch adds the Circadian tab tests (per-arm comparison, notes, controls, table, trace, strip, full-gene exports and the workbook worker protocol) plus the exportProvenance, csv, rhythmScanIdentity and sortableHeaderA11y updates; the circadian tests render CircadianTab directly, so they need no view preload.
